response.text: The dictionary has some claims I should check. It says no void invoices exist (no V appears), and says there are unposted journals (no U appears). I'll check the AP-to-GL linkage, the 'GLJRNL' balance by journal, and whether invoice statuses agree with payments.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbalanced_journals' AS chk, COUNT(*)::text AS v FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT")) x UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_inv_no_jrnl', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_inv_sum_eq_amt_mismatch', COUNT(*)::text FROM (SELECT i."INV_ID" FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING i."STAT_CD"='P' AND COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0)<>i."INV_AMT") y UNION ALL SELECT 'open_inv_with_payments', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'payments_orphan', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'vend_orphan_inv', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APVEND" v WHERE v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_period_orphan', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'acct_orphan_lines', COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" a WHERE a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD") UNION ALL SELECT 'dates_not_8digit', COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN 19000101 AND 29991231;

SELECT h."SRC_CD", h."JRNL_NO", h."MEMO", h."SRC_REF", h."REF_JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT" FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" ORDER BY h."JRNL_NO" LIMIT 8;
